messages:
Marta: Opening a short PR to harmonize wording for audit exports and add examples for migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012. Need quick legal/security read.
Ethan: Can you paste the short intro blurb you'll use so I can confirm it's clear for automation owners?
Marta: Draft intro: "Audit exports provide event-level telemetry for tenant audits and troubleshooting. By default, personal identifiers (for example, email addresses) are de-identified in exported artifacts. Tenants may request inclusion of original identifiers; such requests must be authorized and are recorded in the tenant audit trail. Retention: default 365 days; records under legal hold are retained until released. Exports are encrypted in transit and at rest."
Priya: Legal: prefer the term "personal identifiers" (good), but avoid "de-identified" alone - clarify whether reversible. Suggest: "de-identified (irreversible unless tenant requests mapping export)". Also change "may request" -> "may request inclusion of original identifiers; such requests must be authorized and are recorded."
Marco: Security: include a parenthetical that mapping exports are scoped to tenant admins and require explicit consent. Also add a line: "De-identification is not a substitute for access controls."
Marta: Updated blurb per comments. Also planning to rename the public flag from `redact_personal` -> `deidentify` in the migration examples (this maps to the same backend behavior as the documented `pseudonymize` option). Showing curl, Python, and a quick CSV example to help teams.
Ethan: Please include a short sed snippet to help batch-update scripts across repos.
Marta: Added sed example: `git grep -l "redact_personal" | xargs sed -i 's/redact_personal/deidentify/g'` and a tiny CI test suggestion: `assert not re.search(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}", output_csv)` to ensure no emails in de-identified exports.
docs-bot: lint: please add cross-links to Data Retention Policy and Legal Hold runbook.
Marta: Linked both and fixed a broken anchor in export-playbook (was audit-export-format -> audit-export-guidance). Added a short paragraph about per-tenant opt-ins being recorded as approval events.
ci-bot: docs-ci: preview available for branch docs/audit-deidentify-5012 - https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/audit-export (expires in 48h)
Priya: Final legal tweak: include explicit phrase "documented approval" for opt-ins so auditors can trace it.
Marta: Done and pushed. Requesting final sign-off from Marco/Priya. Will merge after approvals. Thanks all :sparkles:
